Definition: to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia
BiblicalUsage: Kahan is doing the priest's work — to minister, to officiate, to stand before God on behalf of the people. God takes Aaron and his sons to minister unto Him in the priest's office; He sanctifies the tabernacle and the altar and Aaron and his sons to minister; and the chronicler notes the priest who executed the office in Solomon's temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the priesthood was never a job men took up for themselves. God called Aaron, God sanctified him, and God set the pattern — and that is why I hold that ministry still begins with God's call, not with our ambition.
